name: EMPIRICAL_POSTWARM_IDLE_GROUP_ENVELOPE
definition: For each already-measured family/count, retain historical M and take max with the arithmetic mean of each complete THREE-independent-repetition postwarm-idle observation group. No sample maxima, peak memory, device overhead, extrapolated next counts or synthetic padding are inserted. All groups use the same owned worker-family NVML sum and frozen safe factor.
why: Historical one-sample pre-cohort M1 may understate warmed residency; an empirical envelope across existing measured warmup/task scopes reconciles both regimes without shrinking costs to fit outcomes. Same rule applied to E/H shared identities.
group_rule: Dataset/run-series/task or existing 14E context/regime, exactly repetitions1/2/3 with independent PIDs/seeds; exclude invalid/missing/non-isolated sessions.
single_replica_catalog_policy: Update local memory attribute to reconciled M1 solely to satisfy existing loader identity M1==profile.memory; identity/capability/role/quality/s0 and original files unchanged.
new_x3_memory: Arithmetic mean of three x3 postwarm-idle family observations; same empirical envelope definition; existing counts may include newly measured auxiliary x2 group, g2 frozen.
